manaNeeded: {8}{U}{U}{U}{U} plus an additional {1}{U}{U}{U} if Jace is not on the battlefield
description:
Cast Enter the Infinite by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}, drawing your library and then putting any card besides Jace from your hand on top of your library.
If Jace is not on the battlefield, cast it by paying {1}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to mill two cards and win the game due to drawing from an empty library.
